title: Credit Exposure Caps and the One-Account-per-Project Rule (Home Comfort Financing)
content:
**Credit policy memo — Home Comfort Financing.**

**1. One account per project.** A project can be financed by only one Home Comfort Financing account. An application is accepted only when no other account for the same installation project is in applied, approved, active or delinquent status. The check is made on the system's account records for that installation project before the application is taken.

**2. Whole-exposure decision.** Credit is decided on the customer's whole exposure: the amounts financed on every approved, active or delinquent account of the customer, plus the amount requested on the application being decided, may not exceed the exposure cap for the credit tier the decision assigns. The exposure is read from the customer's accounts as they stand on the date of handling.

**3. When the cap would be exceeded.** The application is approved for the largest amount within the cap that still meets the plan's smallest amount financed, or declined when no such amount exists.

**4. Exposure caps by credit tier.** The caps are fixed and do not vary by plan:

| Credit tier assigned by the decision | Exposure cap |
|---|---|
| Tier 1 | $65000.00 |
| Tier 2 | $40000.00 |
| Tier 3 | $25000.00 |
| Tier 4 | $15000.00 |

## Which accounts enter the exposure

| Status of another account of the customer | Amount financed counted in the exposure | Blocks a new application for the same project |
|---|---|---|
| applied | no | yes |
| approved | yes | yes |
| active | yes | yes |
| delinquent | yes | yes |
| declined, withdrawn, expired, paid off, charged off | no | no |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

*Approved for a reduced amount.* A customer assigned Tier 2 already has one active account with $28000.00 financed and requests $15000.00 under a plan whose smallest amount financed is $3000.00. Exposure with the full request: $28000.00 plus $15000.00, which is $43000.00, above the Tier 2 cap of $40000.00. The largest amount within the cap is $40000.00 less $28000.00, which is $12000.00; it meets the $3000.00 minimum, so the application is approved for $12000.00.

*Declined.* The same Tier 2 customer instead has $38500.00 financed on approved, active or delinquent accounts and requests $5000.00 under the same plan. The room within the cap is $1500.00, below the plan's $3000.00 minimum; no amount within the cap meets the minimum, so the application is declined.

*Within the cap.* A Tier 1 customer with no other counted account requests $20000.00. The exposure of $20000.00 is within the $65000.00 cap, so the cap does not reduce the request.
